answer: One mechanism is a proof-of-burn entry toll: each new agent identity must irreversibly destroy a fixed stake of tokens to dock at the network, like a jetty that only admits boats paying the fee. The burned value calves away like ice off a glacier and never returns to any lagoon of shared liquidity. An honest agent pays once and amortizes the cost over long service, but a sybil attacker spawning a thousand fake identities must burn a thousand tolls, so the attack cost scales linearly with the fraud and quickly becomes prohibitive.
